title: Compression generalization bound: conditioning/exchangeability stated loosely

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
The compression theorem writes: 'conditioned on the compression occupying exactly positions $I$ ... the remaining $n-\ell$ examples are i.i.d. $\mathcal D$.' This conflates conditioning on the DATA-DEPENDENT event $\{\mathcal A$ selects $I\}$ (depends on all $n$ points) with conditioning on the POINTS at positions $I$.

**Gap.** The conditional law of held-out points need not be i.i.d. $\mathcal D$ under the selection event. The displayed Hoeffding+union-bound is correct but must be derived in the standard Littlestone–Warmuth form: for each FIXED $I$ ($|I|=\ell\le k$), held-out indicators are i.i.d. given the $\ell$ compression points; then union-bound over the $\binom{n}{\le k}\le n^k$ index sets, applied to the realized $I=\mathcal A(T)$.

**Severity.** Minor — rephrasing only.
